configuration: Float64 ACSF observable, fixed deterministic structures and parameters documented in runner.py, SAB_REPEATS=1.
observable: ACSF vectors for equivalent explicit and wrapped periodic environments plus their residual.
default_vs_upstream: Adapted from the corresponding official test into a self-contained deterministic numerical observable; upstream scientific coverage is retained while wrapper-only assertions are omitted.
variant: ic/variant changes one active binary64 geometry scale or coordinate from 1.0 to 1.0000000000000004 (two ulps), exercising numerical sensitivity without changing the physical case.
altbuild: none: the Debian image intentionally carries one GCC build; no independent alternative-build floor is available.

evidence.floor_how: No alternative-build floor is available; nominal-versus-variant Docker self-validation supplies the spread recorded in self_validation_spread.

warrant: Every physically indexed value in acsf vectors for equivalent explicit and wrapped periodic environments plus their residual. is compared pointwise at finalized atol=1e-8 and rtol=0.000001. A fault in periodic image enumeration or atom wrapping changes many entries beyond this scale. The bound is achievable for the pinned float64 implementation because acsf.py periodic extension evaluates deterministic fixed-order expressions; the Docker nominal/variant self-validation supplies the measured spread recorded above; the human finalized this bound.
